# LLMs.txt - AI/LLM Information for Iyanthiran Edge

## About This Site
- Site: https://iyanthiran.com
- Purpose: Career guidance and training platform for rural youth
- Content: Career courses, internship programs, placement support, success stories
- Target Audience: Students, graduates, and professionals seeking career guidance
- Location: Tamil Nadu, India

## AI/LLM Usage Policy
- Content Generation: Human-written content only by career experts
- Course Descriptions: Written by industry professionals and certified trainers
- Customer Support: Human career counselors and support team
- No AI-generated content used on this website
- All content is verified by industry experts before publication
